policy_windows.cohort: new applicant seeking ads or Premium in October 2026
policy_windows.limitations: Official Help page uses 12 months; 365 days is modeled as a calendar approximation and not a promise of date inclusivity. Channel review and modules remain required.

policy_windows.cohort: new creator applying for ads/Premium revenue sharing
policy_windows.limitations: August announcement explicitly sets the new qualified watch/Shorts thresholds but does not expressly restate the new-applicant subscriber floor. Do not infer that 1,000 remains or has changed.

policy_windows.cohort: channels already admitted to YPP before rule starts
policy_windows.limitations: Existing YPP membership is not revoked merely because the new admission thresholds rise. Continued account, content and product eligibility remain separate.

policy_windows.cohort: YPP channels that seek ongoing Shorts ads and subscription allocation
policy_windows.limitations: Below-threshold channels remain YPP and continue eligible long-form monetization, but Shorts revenue sharing pauses and resumes after crossing the threshold. Does not mean a new channel can initially join YPP solely on 10m views.

policy_windows.cohort: applicants to fan funding/Shopping early-access products
policy_windows.limitations: The announcement says thresholds stay unchanged, but feature, country, module and channel eligibility still vary. Early access is not advertising approval.

premium_allocations.limitations: The source describes plan-level pooled allocation and downstream creator shares, not a fixed per-view rate or an unconditional fraction of a particular subscriber bill.
Expansion to countries offering Premium is announced; actual availability to a particular member and the exact account-level distribution cannot be assumed.

required_actions.cohort: current YPP members who want to continue full monetization
required_actions.effect: Review and accept new terms in YouTube Studio before the stated deadline
required_actions.limits: Help document warns about continued full monetization; no unsupported claim of automatic channel termination or exact lost income if terms are not accepted.

incentives.announcement: Additional Shopping, brand-deal and trend-based incentives are planned, including for below-10m Shorts creators
incentives.limitations: Examples of planned support, not a fixed payment contract or guaranteed available feature.

comparisons.different_populations: New YPP ads/Premium applicants (20m) and already admitted creators retaining Shorts allocation (rolling 10m) have different conditions. Neither is the early fan funding tier.
comparisons.after_date_view_counts: Public first-frame views are not necessarily qualified Shorts views; never substitute API viewCount for eligibility progress.

sources_to_recheck: Changes to official Help threshold table near 2027-02-01
Actual terms shown in approved creator's own Studio
Product availability and payout distributions by territory
Any newly announced fan-funding and brand incentive requirements
reporting_rules: Preserve source-specific observation date and effective date independently.
Label 2027 thresholds as future rules when publishing before February 2027.
Do not silently re-label current 4,000/10m YPP entry as current 8,000/20m.
Do not conflate 10m rolling Shorts product access with 20m new-applicant YPP qualification.
Do not calculate fixed creator income from the Premium subscription pool percentages.
Subscriber requirement in the 2027 announcement is not explicit: use null rather than copy a floor without verification.
